description: Per-client, per-channel consent for MARKETING notifications (campaigns), required before any notificationCampaigns broadcast can be sent. dbo.clients has no consent field today, and Meta requires opt-in for marketing templates plus an easy opt-out; sending promotions to someone who asked to stop also costs money and reputation (quality rating -> lower WhatsApp limits). Scope is marketing only: transactional messages (purchase receipts, ticket ready, operational notices) are never blocked by this table. One row per (companyId, clientId, channel); absence of a row means 'unknown' and is treated as NOT opted in for whatsapp/sms marketing and as opted in for push (the app's own OS permission is the push consent).

fields.name: clientId
fields.description: Client this preference belongs to. UNIQUE (companyId, clientId, channel).

fields.name: marketingOptIn
fields.description: 1 = the client agreed to receive promotions on this channel; 0 = declined or opted out. Campaign audiences include only clients with 1 for at least one channel of the campaign policy, and the cascade skips channels with 0 for that client.

fields.name: source
fields.description: How the consent was captured: pos_checkout (cashier asked, checkbox at sale), client_app (Rewards app settings), whatsapp_keyword (client replied BAJA/STOP or ALTA), admin (manual change, audited). Required so every opt-in can be explained if Meta or a client asks.

fields.name: optedOutAt
fields.description: UTC of the latest opt-out. An opt-out always wins over an older opt-in.

fields.name: updatedByUserId
fields.description: Staff user who changed it (pos_checkout/admin). NULL when the client changed it themselves. Plain INT, no FK constraint: dbo.users has no primary key in the live DB (0 FKs reference it), so any FK to users.userId fails with error 1776.

relationships.notes: Multi-tenant isolation via companyId, injected by the stored procedures from the authenticated session.
One row per channel per client.

frontend.uiPattern: No new page. A 'Promociones' section in the existing client profile (IonToggle per channel with source + date), and an IonCheckbox 'Acepta recibir promociones por WhatsApp' at POS checkout when the client has no row yet. API in src/api/clientContactPreferencesApi.ts.

components.name: ClientMarketingConsent
components.description: Client profile section: one IonToggle per channel (WhatsApp, SMS, Push) showing state, source and date (mxDate). Changing it calls the CRUD endpoint with source=admin; toggle disabled + IonSpinner while saving; useToast on error.

endpoints.description: Internal hook called from the existing WhatsApp inbound webhook (modules/whatsappCloud.py) BEFORE the agent handles the message: if the trimmed, upper-cased body is BAJA, STOP, ALTO or CANCELAR, upsert marketingOptIn=0 for (client resolved by phone within the channel's company, 'whatsapp'), source=whatsapp_keyword, and reply with a fixed confirmation ('Listo, ya no te enviaremos promociones. Responde ALTA para volver a recibirlas.'); ALTA re-opts in. Never echoes the phone in logs (observability redaction).
